newsitem.title: GREECE: Fire still rages on ship docked at Greek port.
newsitem.headline: Fire still rages on ship docked at Greek port.

text.p: Fireboats battled on Wednesday for the second day to control a fire burning aboard a merchant ship docked at the Greek port of Piraeus, with a crewman still missing, an official at the Merchant Marine Ministry said.

Thick black smoke billowed from the stricken Maltese-registered Anafi as fire boats poured water into the engine room, gradually bringing the fire under control. The 74,000-tonne bulk carrier, carrying coal from China to France, had docked for refuelling when the fire started.

"The fire is still burning in the engine room and the accommodation section of the ship. The first mechanic is still missing, and the ship has begun listing slightly," an official said. The rest of the 31 crew members are safe.
